rv.q: But in this cultural hodgepodge the disparate elements don't often cohere.
Though clearly well-intentioned, this off-Broadway attempt at ethnic humor is a swing and a miss.
The mosaic remains a mosaic: colorful, earnest, intermittently delightful, but rarely fused into a singular, resonant picture.
Despite an impressive array of costumes, props and video backdrops, the production has an amateurish air to it.
